meta.title: Chimera Card — Self-custody Visa
meta.description: Use the Chimera Card anywhere Visa is accepted. Powered by licensed partners. Top up via the Chimera Wallet and use your balance in 50+ countries.

spots.heading: 1,000 SPOTS.
spots.body: Once all 1,000 spots are claimed, standard pricing applies — permanently. No waitlist, no retroactive pricing, no exceptions.

benefits.heading: THREE BENEFITS

items.title: 1.5% TRANSACTION FEE FOR LIFE
items.body: Locked for life. Pre-order customers lock in 1.5% forever. Standard rate is 2% — and may rise. Yours won't.

items.title: ZERO MONTHLY FEE
items.body: No subscription. No maintenance charge. No annual fee. No bill.

items.title: ZERO TOP-UP FEES
items.body: Load from your Chimera Wallet at zero cost. Every time.

benefits.disclaimer: *Card programme provided in partnership with Wirex Pay. KYC is required to access the Wirex platform — separate from Chimera's own KYC. Chimera collects no fee or financial advantage for this service.

items.q: How do I apply for a Chimera Card?
items.a: Click "PRE-ORDER NOW" below to reserve your card and lock in lifetime pre-order benefits.

items.q: What happens if I miss the pre-order window?
items.a: You'll pay standard rates with no grandfathered pricing. Pre-order members receive permanent rate protection.

items.q: Are pre-order rates really locked forever?
items.a: Yes. Your fees are frozen at pre-order levels for the lifetime of your account. Standard rates may increase over time, but yours won't.
Yes. Chimera Card uses the same Visa security infrastructure as traditional bank cards.

items.q: How do I top up my Chimera Card?
items.a: Top up directly from your non-custodial Chimera Wallet. It's quick, easy, and secure.
